title: Water Taps
statementMd:
Consider a system of $*n*$ water taps all pouring water into the same container. The $*i*$-th water tap can be set to deliver any amount of water from $0$ to $*a*_{*i*}$ ml per second (this amount may be a real number). The water delivered by $*i*$-th tap has temperature $*t*_{*i*}$.

If for every ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29cd41d3b7a01103f80f7f1a061fdf146ffa49b1.png) you set $*i*$-th tap to deliver exactly $*x*_{*i*}$ ml of water per second, then the resulting temperature of water will be ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/80ff149d627e36b02eb3a7af6ef4c83c177753f1.png) (if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b3732be77fa6132294370a6abded03dbe6bec83a.png), then to avoid division by zero we state that the resulting water temperature is $0$).

You have to set all the water taps in such a way that the resulting temperature is exactly $*T*$. What is the maximum amount of water you may get per second if its temperature has to be $*T*$?

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*T*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200000$, $1 ≤ *T* ≤ 10^{6}$) — the number of water taps and the desired temperature of water, respectively.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}$, $*a*_{2}$, ..., $*a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$) where $*a*_{*i*}$ is the maximum amount of water $*i*$-th tap can deliver per second.

The third line contains $*n*$ integers $*t*_{1}$, $*t*_{2}$, ..., $*t*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$) — the temperature of water each tap delivers.

## Output

Print the maximum possible amount of water with temperature exactly $*T*$ you can get per second (if it is impossible to obtain water with such temperature, then the answer is considered to be $0$).

Your answer is considered correct if its absolute or relative error doesn't exceed $10^{ - 6}$.
statementZhMd:
<statement>

考虑 $*n*$ 个水龙头，它们都向同一个容器中注水。第 $*i*$ 个水龙头可以设置为每秒注入 $0$ 到 $*a*_{*i*}$ 毫升的水（该数值可以是实数）。第 $*i*$ 个水龙头注入的水的温度为 $*t*_{*i*}$。

如果对于每个 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29cd41d3b7a01103f80f7f1a061fdf146ffa49b1.png)，将第 $*i*$ 个水龙头设置为每秒注入恰好 $*x*_{*i*}$ 毫升的水，那么最终水的温度将为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/80ff149d627e36b02eb3a7af6ef4c83c177753f1.png)（如果 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b3732be77fa6132294370a6abded03dbe6bec83a.png)，为避免除以零，我们规定最终水温为 $0$）。

你需要设置所有水龙头，使最终水温恰好为 $*T*$。在水温必须为 $*T*$ 的情况下，每秒最多可以得到多少水？

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*T*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200000$，$1 ≤ *T* ≤ 10^{6}$）——水龙头的数量以及期望的水温。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}$、$*a*_{2}$、...、$*a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$），其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 个水龙头每秒最多可以注入的水量。

第三行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*t*_{1}$、$*t*_{2}$、...、$*t*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$）——每个水龙头注入的水的温度。

## 输出格式

输出每秒能够获得的、温度恰好为 $*T*$ 的水的最大可能总量（如果无法得到该温度的水，则答案视为 $0$）。

如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则视为正确。
</statement>
